name: Break and Steal an Egg
desc:
Welcome to Break and Steal an Egg🥚

🎮 How to Play:

⛏️ Break eggs to hatch rare animals
🐾 Steal them and escape the guards
💰 Place them in your base to earn cash
⚡ Upgrade your speed and pickaxe
🏆 Collect them all in the Index!

❤️ Like the game and join the group for free rewards!
❤️ Game inspired by steal an egg
